NEW MEMBER ACCEPTANCE, COMMITMENT & COMPLIANCE FORM

Official Membership Document – Strictly Confidential

This document constitutes an official membership undertaking between Leo Club Tunis Aspire and the undersigned member/recruit.

By signing this document, the undersigned declares that they have read, understood, accepted and undertaken to strictly comply with the Internal Regulations and By-Laws of Leo Club Tunis Aspire, as well as the decisions, procedures, instructions and legitimate requirements issued by the Club's competent bodies.

Failure to comply with the commitments contained in this document may result in disciplinary measures in accordance with the Internal Regulations.

I. MEMBER IDENTIFICATION

REQUIRED IDENTIFICATION DOCUMENT

The member/recruit shall provide the Club with:

The copy of the CIN and the information collected shall be handled as personal data and used only for legitimate Club-related administrative, membership, organizational, safety, identification and compliance purposes, subject to applicable Tunisian rules on the protection of personal data. The Club's handling of personal data must respect the applicable legal framework in Tunisia.

II. FORMAL MEMBER DECLARATION

I, the undersigned,

hereby declare that I voluntarily request/admit my membership in Leo Club Tunis Aspire and acknowledge that membership in the Club entails responsibilities, obligations and standards of conduct.

I expressly acknowledge that:

The Club's regulations expressly state that membership implies full and unreserved acceptance of the Internal Regulations.

III. MEMBERSHIP STATUS & INTEGRATION PERIOD

I acknowledge that, as a newly admitted member, I may initially hold the status of Recruit Member.

I therefore undertake to:

According to the Internal Regulations, the Recruit Member period has a minimum duration of two months, with a minimum participation requirement of 75% in events/projects.

IV. ATTENDANCE & PARTICIPATION COMMITMENT

I understand that membership is active participation, not merely registration.

I therefore undertake to:

I acknowledge that insufficient participation may affect my evaluation and may result in disciplinary consequences where provided for by the Internal Regulations.

V. POINTING, EVALUATION & PERFORMANCE SYSTEM

I expressly acknowledge the existence of the Club's Activity Pointing and Evaluation Program.

I agree that my participation, attendance, punctuality, teamwork, conduct, initiative, leadership, training participation, responsibility and other relevant contributions may be evaluated according to the applicable pointing system.

I understand that:

I acknowledge that the pointing system is intended to promote discipline, respect, responsibility, active participation and the values of the Club.

VI. STRICT CODE OF CONDUCT & ETHICAL COMMITMENT

I undertake to maintain professional, respectful and exemplary conduct at all times while representing or participating in the activities of Leo Club Tunis Aspire.

I specifically undertake:

The Internal Regulations provide disciplinary measures for misconduct and identify serious offenses that may result in expulsion following the prescribed procedure.

VII. CONFIDENTIALITY & NON-DISCLOSURE UNDERTAKING

I understand that, through my membership, I may have access to confidential or internal information concerning the Club.

I therefore undertake:

The Internal Regulations expressly require members to respect the confidentiality of internal information, events and projects.

VIII. PERSONAL DATA & CIN DOCUMENT

I acknowledge that the Club may collect and process certain personal information necessary for membership administration and Club operations.

This may include, where applicable:

  • Full name
  • Date and place of birth
  • Telephone number
  • Email address
  • Educational information
  • Membership information
  • Attendance and participation records
  • Evaluation information
  • Tunisian CIN number
  • Copy of the CIN
  • Emergency contact information

I undertake to provide accurate information.

I acknowledge that:

The Tunisian INPDP identifies information that directly or indirectly identifies an individual as personal data and provides a framework for its processing.

IX. PHOTOGRAPHY, VIDEO & OFFICIAL COMMUNICATION

I acknowledge that Club activities may involve photography, video recording and official communications.

Regarding the use of my image:

I also undertake:

The Internal Regulations assign responsibility for official communication, public image, photography/video and social media to the appropriate Club structures.

X. FINANCIAL OBLIGATIONS

I acknowledge that membership involves financial obligations established by the Club.

I undertake:

I expressly acknowledge that failure to comply with applicable payment deadlines may result in cancellation, suspension of membership rights or other consequences established by the Internal Regulations.

I further acknowledge that fees and contributions are generally non-refundable in cases of voluntary resignation or expulsion, as provided by the Internal Regulations.

XI. CLUB PROPERTY, DOCUMENTS & DIGITAL ACCESS

Any Club property, material, document, equipment, account, password, access credential, database or other resource entrusted to me remains the property/control of the Club or its authorized entity.

I undertake:

XII. AUTHORITY, RESPONSIBILITY & TEAMWORK

I understand that holding a position, responsibility or role within the Club does not grant unlimited authority.

I undertake:

XIII. DISCIPLINARY PROCEDURE

I acknowledge that failure to respect the Internal Regulations or this undertaking may result in disciplinary action.

Depending on the nature and seriousness of the conduct, measures may include, where applicable:

  • Verbal warning
  • Written warning
  • Point deductions
  • Mandatory meeting with the Board
  • Temporary suspension of privileges
  • Other disciplinary measures provided by the Internal Regulations
  • Expulsion in cases warranting such action

I understand that serious matters may be examined by the Executive Board, that the concerned member may be heard according to the applicable procedure, and that final decisions are taken by the competent authorities specified in the Internal Regulations.

I acknowledge that the disciplinary procedure is not intended to replace the member's right to be heard or the procedures established by the Club's governing documents.

XIV. RESIGNATION & TERMINATION OF MEMBERSHIP

I understand that membership may end through resignation, disciplinary termination or other circumstances provided by the Internal Regulations.

In case of resignation, I undertake to:

I acknowledge that voluntary resignation does not automatically create a right to reimbursement of fees, contributions or amounts already paid where the Internal Regulations provide otherwise.

XV. FINAL ACKNOWLEDGMENT & UNDERTAKING

By signing below, I solemnly declare that:

I understand that membership in Leo Club Tunis Aspire is a responsibility and not merely a title or affiliation. I undertake to uphold the values, reputation, discipline and objectives of the Club.
